provenance_note: Manually transcribed numerical facts checked against the cited original sources. This is a curated derivative, not downloaded model output or measured local data.

future_frontier.provider: Xu et al., Communications Earth & Environment, 2026
future_frontier.spatial_extent: 30 to 83 degrees North; seven-crop aggregate, not a Longyearbyen prediction
future_frontier.limitation: Not our simulation, not actual production migration, not local future temperatures, and not a sustainable agricultural boundary. No 2041-2060 data are claimed. No gridded future climate was acquired in this milestone.

wheat_fao56.provider: FAO, Allen et al. 1998, Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56
wheat_fao56.climate_condition: Table 12 standard non-stressed well-managed crop, subhumid conditions approximately RHmin45%, u2=2m/s
wheat_fao56.limitation: Stage lengths are examples, not Konya or Seyhan phenological measurements. Kc needs local crop, wetting and climatic adjustment. Soil water capacity, initial storage, irrigation efficiency and allocation are NOT supplied by this table.

lettuce_method_comparison.version: 2015 Table 1; source table and method section inspected 2026-09-22
lettuce_method_comparison.conversion: For a same-year output target, source modeled annual water and energy divided by annual output yield intensities: L/kg to m3/kg divide by1000; kJ/kg to kWh/kg divide by3600. Do not divide once more by365. Source S.D. is not a confidence interval.
lettuce_method_comparison.limitation: Engineering/literature model contrasted with conventional budget/statistical data; no Arctic greenhouse measurements. Heating/cooling is strongly site dependent. These coefficients can demonstrate a method tradeoff only with an explicit external-context label, never be silently transferred to Longyearbyen.

seyhan_crop_evidence.provider: Adana İl Tarım ve Orman Müdürlüğü
seyhan_crop_evidence.evidence: Five bread-wheat varieties trialed in Seyhan; reported harvest demonstrates overlapping crop availability with the Konya predecessor.
seyhan_crop_evidence.limitation: Not 2023 yield observations, not a basin average, not independent validation of our new model. Trial yield is not silently used as our optimizer yield.
